description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractDevOpsCommandResponse' which implements the 'DevOpsCommandResponse' interface. It extends 'AbstractCommandResponse' and provides common functionality for DevOps command response objects, including handling optional service name and instance identifier fields, payload appending, and standard overrides like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: AbstractDevOpsCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for DevOps command responses, encapsulating common properties like service name and instance, and methods for payload serialization and equality checks.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name from which the response originated, or empty if not present.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the instance identifier of the service, or empty if not present.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the service name and instance fields to the JSON payload if they satisfy the provided predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the object, including superclass and local fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality, considering the service name, instance, and superclass properties.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to assist with proper equality checks in class hierarchies.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object, including service name, instance, and superclass info.
